CONSTRAINTS:
# CONSTRAINTS

These are hard boundaries. Hooks enforce them on every file write —
a violation blocks the write and wastes a turn.

## When writing CSS files

1. All `@keyframes` declarations must be inside their parent `@layer` block.
2. Every color, size, spacing, radius, shadow, duration and easing comes from a token. No raw values in components.
3. Children own no space outside themselves. Spacing and positioning between siblings is the parent's job — via gap, padding, or a shared container constraint. A child setting margin…
4. Layer order is fixed by tokens. Never invent a z-index.
5. Animate only `transform` and `opacity`.
6. Durations and easing come from motion tokens.
7. **Component** (`--shelf-{component}-*` where component is a UI element name like `chip`, `skeleton`, `button`, `shelf`): aliases scoped to one component. Only that component's CSS…
8. Class selectors use kebab-case: `.chip-bar`, `.card-title`, `.skeleton-pill`. The linter enforces `selector-class-pattern` (kebab-case only).
9. Media queries use range notation: `@media (width >= 768px)`. The linter enforces `media-feature-range-notation` (modern range syntax).

## When writing TS/TSX files

1. Use camelCase for variables and functions, PascalCase for components and types.
2. Prefer named exports over default exports.
3. No nested ternary operators; use switch statements or if/else chains.
4. No `any` types; use `unknown` and narrow.
5. No unsafe casts (`as`); use type guards.
6. All public function parameters and return types must be typed.
7. Placeholder elements (skeletons, spinners, empty-state slots) that occupy the same container as data-driven content use the same HTML element and role as the real content. Do not…
8. Prefer composition over inheritance.
9. Imports stay shallow. Three or more levels of `../` means coupling across module boundaries — import through a barrel file (`index.ts`) or path alias instead.
10. Components perform no I/O. All external calls (HTTP, storage, browser APIs) live in adapter modules. Components call adapters, never raw I/O APIs.
11. Environment variables are read in one place. Source modules receive configuration through injection (props, hooks, arguments), not by reading `process.env` or `import.meta.env`…
12. Comments explain WHY, not WHAT. One line maximum. No multi-line `//` blocks, no JSDoc (`/** */`) on internal code.

## When writing test files

1. Find elements by role and accessible name, never by CSS selector.

## All files

1. Every project must include a `@layer base` that applies design tokens to bare HTML elements. This is the layer where the design system takes control from the browser UA…
2. Source comments describe current behavior, not delivery plans. References to ticket state rot immediately.
